about: Tin Hat mini games v1 (spec rev 2): every visible word both apps show for games, byte-identical in the desktop and the web (GAMES-V1-SPEC.md). {n}, {max}, {who}, {space}, {owner}, {person} are filled in by the app. Card rules are the spec's §5.0 table in plain words.

optin.title: Play chips
optin.body: Tin Hat counts your time in calls in {space} to give you play chips there. They're play money only.
optin.small: Chips can't be bought, sold, cashed out or sent anywhere. They stay in {space}, kept by {owner}. You can delete them in Settings → Games.

moon-monday.name: Moon Monday
moon-monday.rule: Bet 1 or 3: reel 2 becomes a Moon.

twos-company.name: Two's Company
twos-company.rule: Bet 2: if reel 3 matches reel 1, reel 3 is re-rolled.

big-bet-tax.name: Big Bet Tax
big-bet-tax.rule: Bet 3: the payout is halved (rounded down).

cold-streak.name: Cold Streak
cold-streak.rule: After a loss, a pair pays 0.

skim.name: Skim
skim.rule: Any win pays 1 less (after every multiplier).

moon-tax.name: Moon Tax
moon-tax.rule: A Moon on any reel: the payout is 0.

shy-hat.name: Shy Hat
shy-hat.rule: A Hat on reel 2 is re-rolled.

lizard-tax.name: Lizard Tax
lizard-tax.rule: A Lizard on reel 2: the payout is 0.

underdog.name: Underdog
underdog.rule: A pair: bet 1 pays double, bet 3 pays 0.

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.rule: After exactly 1 loss: double. After exactly 2: 0.

hot-hat.name: Hot Hat
hot-hat.rule: No Hat last spin and a pair: 0. A Hat on reel 1 last spin: double.

even-money.name: Even Money
even-money.rule: Bet 2 and a pair: double. Bet 1 or 3 and a Hat pair or three of a kind: half.

settings.intro: Texas Hold'em and The Rig, played in calls. Play chips are play money only: they can't be bought, sold, cashed out or sent anywhere. Each space has its own chips, kept by the server the space was made on.
settings.earn: You earn 1 chip per hour in a call with others (up to 8 a day).
settings.not_opted: You haven't opened a game in {space} yet. Nothing is counted until you do.
settings.delete_body: Your chips and prestige in {space} are deleted and your call time there stops counting. The server's books keep their entries without your name. Game cards already in chat stay. If you come back within 30 days you start at 0 chips (after that, fresh).
settings.none: You haven't played in any space yet. Chips belong to a space: open a game from a call in a room of that space.
settings.frozen: You left this space: these chips are kept but not counted until you rejoin.
settings.how_earning: Chips for the time you're in a call with someone else in that space's rooms (not alone, not BRB, and you talked, showed a camera or screen, or played in the last 30 minutes): 1 chip every 15 minutes unless the space's admins changed it, up to the space's daily limit. Only after you've opened a game there once.
settings.how_broke: Once a day, if you're at exactly 0, you're topped up to 5.
settings.how_cap: Your cap is 100 + 50 × your prestige. Leave a game at or over your cap and you go back to 10 chips and up one prestige: the tin hat by your name gets fancier.
settings.delete_desc: Removes your chips and prestige there and stops counting your call time there.
